thread:
maria: Heads up — we're doing a soft open of a small H200P edge pool in Kigali (af-rw-1) for Dedicated customers in preview. Pool is live for internal validation and a handful of enterprise customers. We want to validate latency profiles and burst behavior before broad availability.

ian: Size/scope?

maria: Initial footprint: 8 x H200P across 2 racks (zone-a, zone-b). Reserved for Dedicated preview enrollments; burst policy will allow up to +30% short-term capacity for eligible accounts. Expected to support up to ~220 tokens/s aggregate at p50 for typical seq=512 workloads.

jules: Any SLA changes for preview?

maria: Preview = no formal SLA. We will provide 99.9% best-effort; for enterprise previews we can set local SLOs per-customer via contracts. Please route customer asks to @carmen.

ian: Routing/fallback: requests will prefer af-rw-1, fallback to eu-west-1 if capacity constrained. Cache KV replication will be disabled for preview (we're testing sync behavior).

ops-bot: deploy job #deploy-1769001200 started -> provisioning 8 h200p nodes in af-rw-1. Logs: https://internal.builds/1769001200

carmen: Sales note — pricing for burst uses the 'preview-burst' rate card (outlined in doc). Is there a short blurb I can share?

maria: Short blurb: "Kigali H200P Dedicated (Preview): limited capacity, regional preview pricing. Burst capacity available; billed at preview-rate while in soft-open. Contact sales for enrollment." I'll add to the internal preview doc: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/previews/kigali-h200p

jules: Any known constraints? network/storage?

maria: NVLink configured per-rack, but we still see ~10-20ms p95 when pulling cold weights from warm-pools. Prefetch patch is scheduled tonight (00:30 UTC) — expect transient errors during the rollout. We'll enable auto-retry at the routing layer for preview customers.

ian: Ops command to reserve preview slots (internal tool):
```sh
rctl reserve --region af-rw-1 --gpu h200p --count 2 --tag preview
```

carmen: Thanks — I will prep a short customer triage doc and ping legal for T&Cs.

maria: Action items: (1) infra: monitor kernel hotplug during prefetch (jules). (2) platform: enable fallback rule to eu-west-1 after 5s (ian). (3) sales: outreach lists for limited enroll (carmen). Please react with :eyes: when done.

ops-bot: monitor alert created -> #kigali-h200p-preview (oncall escalation set to eng-oncall after 30m).

jules: Marking follow-up in eng-sre for post-mortem after first 24h. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks team — rolling soft-open now. Expect follow-ups in this thread with metrics and any incidents.
